packageRules.description: OpenCloud production + rolling base images track upstream's own floating :latest tag directly (see Dockerfile) -- no version to pin, no PR to merge. The weekly cron rebuild in build.yml keeps them current instead. Disabled here so Renovate does not propose pinning either to a digest, which would reintroduce the same PR-per-update friction one level down.
Static gosu privilege-drop helper image (multi-stage COPY --from)
GitHub Actions: auto-merge all updates. No CI runs on PRs, so platformAutomerge merges as soon as the PR is open.
